description: This file implements an Angular route guard that checks user authentication status before allowing access to certain routes. It redirects unauthenticated users to the login page, passing the originally requested URL for navigation after login.

methods.name: authGuard
methods.description: A standalone Angular route guard function that implements CanActivateFn. It verifies user authentication status asynchronously and redirects to login if necessary.
